# Acnologia

> Acnologia is a self-hosted API key pool. It stores many API keys per provider (SerpAPI, ElevenLabs, Brave Search, Gemini, or any API key based HTTP service), hands out a working key on demand, detects rate limits, quota exhaustion and suspended accounts, cools keys down and rotates to the next one. Agents use it either as a proxy (Acnologia injects the key and the secret is never exposed) or by leasing a key and reporting the outcome.

Base URL is wherever Acnologia is deployed, for example `http://localhost:8080`. All consumer calls need an app token (`acn_...`) created in the dashboard. All bodies are JSON. Errors look like `{"error": {"code": "string", "message": "string"}}`.

Key facts for agents:

- Prefer proxy mode. Call `/proxy/{service}/{provider path}` exactly as you would call the provider, minus the provider key. Acnologia retries with the next key on rate limits.
- Use lease mode only when you must hold the raw key (for example a provider SDK). Always report the outcome so bad keys cool down and the key's concurrency slot is released.
- An app may be limited to some services and to mode `proxy`, `lease` or `both`. Call `GET /api/v1/services` to see what you can use.
- HTTP 503 `no_key_available`: every key is cooling down or exhausted. Wait `retry_after_sec` seconds.
- HTTP 503 `all_keys_busy`: usable keys exist but every one is at its concurrency limit. Retry after `retry_after_sec` (usually 1) or lease with `wait_sec`.
- HTTP 503 `service_unavailable`: the provider keeps failing and its circuit breaker is open. Wait `retry_after_sec`.
- HTTP 429 `app_limit_reached`: your app used up its daily or monthly request or budget limit. `reset_at` says when it lifts.
- Report every lease within 10 minutes of `expires_at`. A second report gets 409, a late one 410.
- `{service}` can also be a service group: Acnologia tries each member in order. `X-Acnologia-Service` says which member answered.
- Acnologia never sends a key to Claude: requests from its own AI features pass a redactor, and keys pasted into its Assistant are vaulted.

## Auth

- `Authorization: Bearer acn_...` (preferred), or `X-Acnologia-Token: acn_...`.
- Proxy only: query parameter `?acn_token=acn_...` for tools that only accept a URL.
- Acnologia strips these before forwarding upstream.

## Consumer API

- [GET /api/v1/services](/llms-full.txt): services this token may use, with `available`, `base_url` and `auth` `{type, name, prefix}`.
- [POST /api/v1/lease](/llms-full.txt): body `{"service": "serpapi", "exclude_key_ids": [], "ttl_sec": 300, "wait_sec": 0, "exclusive": false}`, returns `{"lease_id", "key_id", "service", "secret", "auth": {"type", "name", "prefix"}, "base_url", "expires_at"}` (put `prefix` before the secret when present), or 503 `no_key_available` / `all_keys_busy` with `retry_after_sec`.
- [POST /api/v1/leases/{lease_id}/report](/llms-full.txt): body `{"outcome", "status_code", "retry_after_sec", "message", "rotate"}`, returns `{"ok": true, "next": <lease or null>}`. With `rotate: true`, `next` is a fresh lease on another key.
- [POST /api/v1/leases/{lease_id}/renew](/llms-full.txt): body `{"ttl_sec"}`, returns `{"ok": true, "expires_at"}`.
- [ANY /proxy/{service}/{path}](/llms-full.txt): forwards to `base_url/{path}` with query string and body, injecting a key. Response headers add `X-Acnologia-Key-Id`, `X-Acnologia-Attempts`, `X-Acnologia-Service` and, with caching, `X-Acnologia-Cache`. Redirects are returned, not followed. Send `Cache-Control: no-cache` to skip the cache and `Idempotency-Key: <id>` to make retries safe for 10 minutes.
- [GET /healthz](/llms-full.txt): `{"ok": true, "version": "..."}`, no auth.

## Outcomes

- `ok`: call succeeded, resets the key's failure counter.
- `rate_limited`: key cools down for `retry_after_sec` (at most 24h), or exponential backoff from the service cooldown, capped at 1h.
- `busy`: the account is at its concurrency limit. The key steps aside for `retry_after_sec` (default 1s) without backoff.
- `quota_exhausted`: key parked as `exhausted` until its quota resets (or 24h).
- `invalid`: key marked `invalid` and removed from rotation until a health check passes.
- `banned`: the provider suspended the account. Only an admin reset brings it back.
- `error`: provider or network failure that is not the key's fault. The key is not penalized.

## Examples

- SerpAPI search: `GET /proxy/serpapi/search.json?engine=google&q=coffee` with `Authorization: Bearer acn_...`. Do not send `api_key`.
- ElevenLabs text to speech: `POST /proxy/elevenlabs/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}` with JSON `{"text": "Hello", "model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2"}` and `Accept: audio/mpeg`. Do not send `xi-api-key`.
- The dashboard's Integrate tab has the same calls in curl, Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, C#, C++, Swift, Kotlin, PHP, Ruby and Dart.

## MCP

- [POST /mcp](/llms-full.txt): MCP streamable HTTP endpoint (JSON responses), same app token. Core tools: `list_services`, `pool_status`, `get_key`, `renew_key`, `report_key`, `proxy_request`. Apps can also enable service tools generated from provider examples, read only insights (`list_keys`, `key_details`, `service_stats`) and key management (`check_keys`, `set_key_status`, `add_keys`). Stdio clients can run `acnologia mcp --url <base> --token acn_...`.

## SDKs

Every SDK's lease call and `with_key` helper accept a wait option and raise a distinct busy error that still counts as "no key available". `with_key` always reports its leases.

- [Python](/llms-full.txt): `pip install acnologia`, then `from acnologia import Acnologia`.
- [TypeScript and JavaScript](/llms-full.txt): `npm install @acnologia/keys`, then `import { Acnologia } from "@acnologia/keys"`. Node 18+, Bun, Deno, browsers.
- [Go](/llms-full.txt): `go get github.com/sidharthpunathil/acnologia/sdk/go`, package `acnologia`.
- [PHP](/llms-full.txt): `composer require acnologia/keys`, class `Acnologia\Acnologia`.
- [Ruby](/llms-full.txt): `gem install acnologia`, then `require "acnologia"` and `Acnologia::Client.new`.

## Admin API and CLI

Operators can script the admin API with a token from Account, API tokens (`Authorization: Bearer acnadm_...`, scope `read`, `write` or `admin`, never above the creator's role). The `acn` CLI (`curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sidharthpunathil/acnologia/main/install.sh | sh`, also built in as `acnologia ctl`) signs in through the browser with `acn login`, or takes a token with `acn login https://keys.example.com --token acnadm_...`; then `acn status`, `services`, `keys <service>`, `keys add <service> < keys.txt`, `keys check <service>`, `events`, `breaker <service> [--reset]`, `cache purge <service>`, `usage <app-id>`.
